references.text: Describes the tribes that had not yet received their inheritance, which forms the background for the situation in Joshua 18:2
Refers to the distribution of inheritance by casting lots, the same method to be used for the remaining tribes
The tribe of Judah received its inheritance, unlike the seven tribes that were still waiting
Joseph's sons received their inheritance, which reduced the number of tribes waiting for distribution
Moses gave an inheritance to Gad, Reuben, and half the tribe of Manasseh east of the Jordan; these were not among the seven remaining
God's command that nine and a half tribes should receive an inheritance in Canaan, providing the background for the land distribution
Joshua distributed the inheritance by casting lots for the seven tribes mentioned in verse 2
